items.name: Athens SNFestival Cubing 2019
items.information: Athens SNFestival Cubing 2019 is part of the Summer Nostos Festival. Feel free to check out the schedule of the festival as well (https://www.snfestival.org/en/snfestival/) and join in the rest of the speedcubing activities. The cube will be a part of the festival and the highlight will be the official competition. Festival schedule for speedcubing 26-06: Workshops for beginners and mosaic building 27-06: Workshops for speedcubers and mosaic building 28-06: Special guests, mosaic building and unofficial fun competition 29-06: WCA competition
